quote: “For there is no friend like a sister / In calm or stormy weather; / To cheer one on the tedious way, / To fetch one if one goes astray, / To lift one if one totters down, / To strengthen whilst one stands.”
source: Christina Rossetti, Goblin Market, lines 562 to 567, Goblin Market and Other Poems (Macmillan, 1862) (Laura)
speaker: Laura

evidence.where: Project Gutenberg ebook 16950, the World’s Classics reprint of the 1862 Goblin Market and Other Poems text, which carries line numbers; line 560 is marked at Then joining hands to little hands, so the closing six lines are 562 to 567, spoken by Laura to the children. Wording matches exactly.
evidence.edition: Goblin Market and Other Poems (Macmillan, 1862), as reprinted in The World’s Classics
evidence.locator: Goblin Market, lines 562 to 567, the closing lines
